findings.title: Light theme value accidentally changed from 30% to 70% in .topic-meta-data h5 a
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`. The light-theme argument (first parameter of dark-light-choose) changed from 30% to 70%, which will alter the appearance on light themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))` to preserve the existing light-theme behavior.

findings.title: Light theme value accidentally changed from 70% to 30% in .custom-message-length
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`. The light-theme argument changed from 70% to 30%, which will make the text significantly darker on light themes. It should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%))`.

findings.title: Light theme value changed from 30% to 50% in .group-member-info .name
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%, making the name text lighter on light themes than before. If the intent was to preserve light-theme appearance, it should be `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 70%))`.

findings.title: Light theme value changed from 30% to 50% in .group-member-info .name
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme lightness changed from 30% to 50%, making the name text lighter on light themes than before. This is the same issue as in desktop/user.scss.

findings.title: Light theme value changed from 20% to 50% in .topic-map h3
findings.body: The original value was `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%)` but the replacement uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The light-theme lightness changed from 20% to 50%, making the heading significantly lighter on light themes. The desktop counterpart (desktop/topic-post.scss line 321) correctly uses `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 80%))`.

findings.title: .category .badge-notification not converted to dark-light-choose
findings.body: Line 115 still uses `color: scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` without wrapping in `dark-light-choose(...)`. Given the PR's stated purpose of fixing scale-color for dark themes, this appears to be an oversight. All other similar patterns in the same file and across the codebase have been converted.
